title: Compliance checks: penalties for CIS payments or returns connected to deliberate non-compliance — CC/FS96
text:
Factsheets are for guidance only and reflect HMRC’s position at the time of writing.

 This factsheet gives information about:

 • when we may charge you a penalty

 • how we work out the amount of a penalty

 • how we’ll tell you about a penalty

 • company officer liability

 • your rights if we’re considering penalties
